en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches being cut off while the git server was still reporting progress on a large repository; `CLAUDE_RUNNER_FETCH_SERVER_PROGRESS_CAP_MS` tunes or turns off the wait
zh: 自托管运行器：修复了在大型仓库上 git 服务器仍在报告进度时 git fetch 被中断的问题；`CLAUDE_RUNNER_FETCH_SERVER_PROGRESS_CAP_MS` 可调整或关闭该等待
